messages.subject: Work session today
parts:
Hi all,

We'll have our regular D-RUG work session today at 1-3PM in Wickson 2124.  This will be our last session at the summer time before we move to the new time next week.

This week will be just the open work session / Q&A time we've been having all summer.  Next week will be our organizational meeting for the fall quarter and I will be giving a brief tutorial on new debugging tools coming out in the next version of RStudio.

As usual, I'll bring cookies.

- Noam
